name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RecAt.stable
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V : List.{0} Nat} {D A B : Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
      LE.le.{0} 200 (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
        LT.lt.{0} D 200 →
          Ne.{1} D DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP →
            D ∉ V →
              LT.lt.{0} A 200 →
                Ne.{1} A DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP →
                  A ∉ V →
                    LT.lt.{0} B 200 →
                      Ne.{1} B DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP →
                        B ∉ V →
                          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RecAt m D A B → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RecAt m' D A B

source.code:
theorem RecAt.stable {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} {D A B : ℕ} (hag : Agree m m' V) (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN)
    (hhp : 200 ≤ m HP) (hD : D < 200) (hDH : D ≠ HP) (hDV : D ∉ V) (hA : A < 200) (hAH : A ≠ HP) (hAV : A ∉ V)
    (hB : B < 200) (hBH : B ≠ HP) (hBV : B ∉ V) (h : RecAt m D A B) : RecAt m' D A B := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  have hD' : m' D = m D := hag.var D (lt_hp hhp hD) hDH hDV
  refine ⟨by rw [hD']; exact h1, by rw [hD']; exact le_trans h2 hag.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hD', hag.heap hV _ h1 (by omega), hag.var A (lt_hp hhp hA) hAH hAV]; exact h3
  · rw [hD', hag.heap hV _ (by omega) (by omega), hag.var B (lt_hp hhp hB) hBH hBV]; exact h4
